projecthero.guide.omnitrix.alien.eye_guy: An Opticoid: a slim yellow alien covered in eyes, with a great eye in his chest. His eyes fire beams -- a green laser, a freezing ice beam, a fire beam, or six lasers at once from all over his body -- and his chest eye charges up one huge beam. He sees in every direction: nothing sneaks up on him, Blindness never takes him, and All-Seeing (V) shows him every creature nearby through walls. He is frail, though. He is not on the dial at first: an 11th mistransform (or 22nd, 33rd...) may find him, and from then on you can dial him.
projecthero.omnitrix.eye_guy.eye_laser.d: A green laser from your eyes at the crosshair (32 blocks): 7.
projecthero.omnitrix.eye_guy.laser_volle: Six eyes fire at once, each at a creature in front of you (20 blocks): 6 each. All six hit the same creature if it is alone.
projecthero.omnitrix.eye_guy.freeze_beam: An ice-blue beam (24 blocks): 12, and the creature is slowed hard (Slowness IV) and frozen over for 4 s.
projecthero.omnitrix.eye_guy.fire_beam.d: An orange beam (24 blocks): 12, and the creature is set alight for 5 s.
projecthero.omnitrix.eye_guy.eye_dodge.d: A quick hop the way you are moving (straight back when standing still). Nothing can hit you for 0.4 s.
projecthero.omnitrix.eye_guy.chest_eye_b: Ultimate: your chest eye charges for 1.5 s (you are slowed), then fires a huge beam (36 blocks) through everything on its line: 32 each, knocked back.
projecthero.omnitrix.eye_guy.eye_flash.d: Every eye flashes at once: everything within 9 blocks takes 5, is blinded for 3 s and dazed for 1.5 s, and mobs lose track of you.
For 12 s every creature within 40 blocks shows through walls (only you see it), and you can see in the dark.
projecthero.omnitrix.eye_guy.opticoid.de: Eyes in the back of your head: hits from behind do 25% less.
projecthero.omnitrix.eye_guy.many_eyes.d: One eye is always open: Blindness and Darkness never take you.
projecthero.omnitrix.eye_guy.soft_body.d: Thin and frail: 28 health and very light armour.
projecthero.omnitrix.eye_guy.dazzled.des: While you are burning your eyes water: your beams do half damage.
projecthero.omnitrix.info.eye_guy.role: Beam caster: lasers, ice and fire from range, one huge chest beam, and he sees everything.
projecthero.omnitrix.info.eye_guy.passiv: Opticoid: hits from behind do 25% less.
Many Eyes: Blindness and Darkness never take him.
All-Seeing (V): every creature within 40 blocks shows through walls.
projecthero.omnitrix.info.eye_guy.weakne: Soft Body: 28 health and very light armour.
Dazzled: his beams do half while he is burning.
Not on the dial until a mistransform (the 11th, 22nd, 33rd...) finds him.
